## 7. Unresolved channel expressions (could not map to a string statically)

Typically the dag instance points at a config file that lacks the topic field, or the channel is built at runtime.

| component | dag instance | kind | msg type | expression |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CameraComponent | modules/drivers/camera/dag/camera_no_compress.dag | Writer | Image | camera_config_->raw_channel_name() |
| LatencyStatisticComponent | modules/statistics/latency/dag/latency_statistic.dag | Reader | T | channel_name |
| PlanningComponent | modules/planning/planning_component/dag/planning_navi.dag | Reader | ControlInteractiveMsg | config_.topic_config().control_interative_topic() |
| PlanningComponent | modules/planning/planning_component/dag/planning_navi.dag | Reader | MapMsg | config_.topic_config().relative_map_topic() |
| PlanningComponent | modules/planning/planning_component/dag/planning_navi.dag | Reader | PadMessage | config_.topic_config().planning_pad_topic() |
| PlanningComponent | modules/planning/planning_component/dag/planning_navi.dag | Reader | PlanningCommand | config_.topic_config().planning_command_topic() |
| PlanningComponent | modules/planning/planning_component/dag/planning_navi.dag | Reader | Stories | config_.topic_config().story_telling_topic() |
